fallbackText:
Desert camp: left and right
Practice saying where things are in Korean.
Place the camels to the left of the tents, from your own view. Then say in Korean where the camels are.
Tiles: 낙타 (camels), 텐트 (tents)
Hint 1: Left is 왼쪽 and right is 오른쪽.
Hint 2: To say something is somewhere, use 있어요 (is there).
Hint 3: Pattern: A가 B ___에 있어요. Fill in the side.
